notes.title: Minor quality of life patch
notes.content:
Neonis got a minor quality of life patch, including:
[list]
[*] a few smaller bug fixes
[*] increased performance (less lag)
[*] improved visibility in certain aspects
[/list]

notes.title: Tower defense update
notes.content:
Neonis just got its first major update!

Now introducing a tower defense gamemode. Build different kind of towers to defeat waves of enemies. These towers can eventually be combined into combo towers with new different abilities!

Also added a few small tips in the death screen.
